context.method: Static extraction from pinned Git objects: native descriptor constructors and function factories, registry lookup-only tools, both immutable shell configurations, fixed extension-management definitions, memory and LSP/Dreaming leaf registrations, plus model-facing rg. Dynamic descriptions use explicitly source-backed summaries.

referenceProfile.label: Illustrative online, local, top-level coding baseline; not a universal product default
referenceProfile.agentMode: interactive, no prior armed plan/autopilot mode
referenceProfile.optionalCapabilitiesAndExperiments: not assumed; conditional entries explain their own gates
referenceProfile.scope: Pre-permission advertised native selection. Execution permissions, sandboxing, model eligibility, feature policy, and host registrations remain authoritative.

defaultStatusDefinitions.baseline-enabled: The literal composition gate includes the tool under the stated profile, before later tool/agent filters. Not a promise across hosts or models.
defaultStatusDefinitions.conditional: Requires model, capability, service, policy, experiment, agent request, or mode conditions; compiled does not mean default-on.
defaultStatusDefinitions.platform-specific: One platform's shell family; baseline on its corresponding platform, not all platforms simultaneously.
defaultStatusDefinitions.internal: Shipped descriptor for a literal/internal/specialized context, not an ordinary coding default.

context.inheritedCoding: Leave runtime selection intact: do not turn this inventory into an availableTools allowlist and do not force every catalog member on. Keeping a tool means preserving the runtime's own model/platform/capability/experiment choices.
context.parametersSemantics: Every parameters string is an intentionally small JSON object schema for an ILLUSTRATIVE CUSTOM OVERRIDE. It is not the native input signature, including for grammar-based tools. No native schemas are claimed by these examples.

inputKindDefinitions.json-object: The extracted native descriptor uses a function-style input; the exact schema can vary by session.
inputKindDefinitions.custom-grammar: The extracted native descriptor uses custom/grammar input rather than a JSON function signature.
inputKindDefinitions.specialized-json: Tool-search has specialized composition/dispatch despite JSON-shaped callback input; it is overrideable.

context.workspaceSemantics: True marks direct native project/host file-shell operations or conservatively flagged delegated/opaque host effects for workspace-free warnings. False does not mean no network, storage, permission checks, or incidental filesystem I/O. Session-owned state is distinguished from arbitrary project/host-file access. Per-tool defaultReason explains conservative or storage-only cases.
context.overrideSemantics: True requires positive membership in the native built-in override recognizer (including its specialized tool-search path), except explicitly reserved catalog_search. It does not enable a disabled tool or bypass permissions. False for other fixed leaf/management surfaces is conservative: this snapshot does not infer support from name-collision acceptance alone.
context.aliasSemantics: Selection aliases are not extra native descriptors. Targets match only tools actually available; duplicate alias definitions are last-wins. Historical targets such as search and the projected MCP web_search name do not manufacture new built-in catalog members.
variants: ask_user_2 is a structured schema/description variant under canonical ask_user, not an additional model-facing tool name.
grep and rg share the content-search implementation; editing style determines the offered name.
generic_tool_search is a compiled internal descriptor variant; tool_search_tool is the specialized model-facing/client-override surface.
SQL, session history, task/agent, memory, shell, and skill descriptions/schemas are specialized from session facts.
excludedSurfaces: Dynamic MCP tools, including GitHub MCP/provider-projected web_search; they are not enumerated as static native descriptors.
Dynamically contributed extension/plugin tools, custom external tools, and custom-agent registrations.
Provider/transport orchestration envelopes with no native descriptor constructor in the pinned registry surfaces.
Selection aliases are preserved in context.aliases, not duplicated as invented tool descriptors.
limitations: A static reference profile cannot prove a particular authenticated host's live enabled set. No sessions, authentication, experiments, or model/network calls were used.
Both platform shell families and linked leaf descriptors are included; membership is source-backed, not a claim that every build links every leaf.
Native dynamic descriptions are summarized rather than evaluating session services. Illustrative override inputs intentionally do not reproduce native schemas.
update_todo is in the core registry but not a dedicated operation of the legacy tool_assembly_plan; it remains conditional rather than advertised as a universal default.
The source-bound capture reader evaluates only static Rust expressions. It fails on new descriptor names lacking policy or unresolved descriptions rather than silently curating a smaller catalog.

tools.name: apply_patch
tools.label: Applying patch
tools.description: Use the `apply_patch` tool to edit files. This is a FREEFORM tool, so do not wrap the patch in JSON.
tools.defaultReason: Model-dependent editing/search alternative, not an additional always-on editor. Apply-patch style selects rg and apply_patch; replace style selects str_replace_editor and omits standalone view/create/edit.

tools.name: ask_user
tools.label: Asking user
tools.description: Ask the user a question and wait for their response. Use this tool when you need to ask the user questions during execution. This allows you to: 1. Gather user preferences or requirements 2. Clarify ambiguous instructions 3. Get decisions on implementation choices as you work 4. Offer choices to the user about what direction to take
tools.defaultReason: Requires ask-user capability plus a structured ask-user surface or user-input listener. The ask_user_2 implementation changes the schema under the same canonical ask_user name.

tools.name: bash
tools.label: Run Bash commands
tools.description: Runs a Bash command on the host; supports foreground and background command sessions.
tools.defaultReason: Non-Windows shell family; selected on the macOS/Linux reference platform before later filters. The Windows family uses powershell/read_powershell/stop_powershell/list_powershell.

tools.name: catalog_search
tools.label: Discovering resources
tools.description: Search for agentic resources through the runtime's bounded discovery API. Use only after loading the discover-resources skill.
tools.defaultReason: Requires a trusted discovery skill in the model-invocable catalog. Reserved: external tools are explicitly forbidden from defining or overriding catalog_search.

tools.name: context_board
tools.label: Context Board
tools.description: Manage the dynamic context board. Supports four commands: - "get": Retrieve the full content of a context item. Requires `src` and `name`. - "add": Add or update an item on the board. Requires `name`, `description`, and `context`. - "prune": Remove an agent-created item from the board. Requires `name`. - "get_board": List all items on the board with their metadata. No additional parameters required.
tools.defaultReason: Requires dynamic-context availability and a literal agent-definition request; not a wildcard-enabled coding tool.

tools.name: create
tools.label: Creating file
tools.description: Tool for creating new files. * Creates a new file with the specified content at the given path * Cannot be used if the specified path already exists * Parent directories must exist before creating the file * Path *MUST* be absolute
tools.defaultReason: Enabled for the reference profile's split editing style. Other models select rg/apply_patch or the combined str_replace_editor instead; later allow/exclude and agent filters still apply.

tools.name: dynamic_workflows_manage
tools.label: Managing workflows
tools.description: Manage registered agent workflows (formerly factories): discover definitions, inspect runs and resumable work, and, when enabled, author session-scoped JavaScript workflows.
tools.defaultReason: Experimental. Requires dynamic-workflow availability, including session capabilities/feature and quota policy. Workflows (formerly factories) can launch agents; authoring can write session-scoped JavaScript on the host. Not positively recognized by the native built-in override dispatcher; this snapshot does not promise an override for this fixed surface.

tools.name: edit
tools.label: Editing file
tools.description: Tool for making string replacements in files. * Replaces exactly one occurrence of `old_str` with `new_str` in the specified file * When called multiple times in a single response, edits are independently made in the order calls are specified * The `old_str` parameter must match EXACTLY one or more consecutive lines from the original file * If `old_str` is not unique in the file, replacement will not be performed * Make sure to include enough context in `old_str` to make it unique * Path *MUST* be absolute
tools.defaultReason: Enabled for the reference profile's split editing style. Other models select rg/apply_patch or the combined str_replace_editor instead; later allow/exclude and agent filters still apply.

tools.name: execution_subagent
tools.label: Execution subagent
tools.description: Runs terminal commands in a constrained execution-only subagent and returns a focused summary instead of raw command output.
tools.defaultReason: Requires online mode, the execution-subagent feature/experiment, and session/model availability. Delegates host command execution; not a universal default. Not positively recognized by the native built-in override dispatcher; this snapshot does not promise an override for this fixed surface.

tools.name: exit_plan_mode
tools.label: Plan ready for review
tools.description: Exit plan mode and return to normal interactive mode. Use this tool when you have created a plan and want to get user approval before implementing. Provide a summary of the plan for the user to review. For highly parallelizable implementation work (or parallelizable todos), set `showFleet` to also offer the autopilot + /fleet option and usually recommend `autopilot_fleet`.
tools.defaultReason: Requires active plan mode, plan-mode capability, and a responder; cache-stability treatment can retain the descriptor outside plan mode without invoking approval.

tools.name: extensions_manage
tools.label: Managing extensions
tools.description: Manage the Copilot CLI extension ecosystem.
tools.defaultReason: Fixed runtime extension-management tools require an active extension service with management tools enabled. They can read/write extension files or restart host subprocesses; dynamically contributed extension tools are outside this static catalog. Not positively recognized by the native built-in override dispatcher; this snapshot does not promise an override for this fixed surface.

tools.name: extensions_reload
tools.label: Reloading extensions
tools.description: Reload all extensions from disk. Call this after creating or modifying extension files in .github/extensions/ or the user extensions directory. New tools are available immediately after reload.
tools.defaultReason: Fixed runtime extension-management tools require an active extension service with management tools enabled. They can read/write extension files or restart host subprocesses; dynamically contributed extension tools are outside this static catalog. Not positively recognized by the native built-in override dispatcher; this snapshot does not promise an override for this fixed surface.

tools.name: fetch_copilot_cli_documentation
tools.label: Checking my documentation
tools.description: Fetch authoritative GitHub Copilot CLI README/help for questions about your capabilities, usage, or features.
tools.defaultReason: Requires cli-documentation capability; it is not automatically present in every runtime host.

tools.name: file_search
tools.label: File Search
tools.description: Find workspace files whose paths match a glob pattern.
tools.defaultReason: Constrained search-agent tools materialized only for literal requests, not ordinary parent coding defaults. Preserve these names: their schemas/behavior differ from view/grep/glob and remote code-search tools.

tools.name: generic_tool_search
tools.label: Search tools
tools.description: Search for tools in the tool registry to discover capabilities for completing the current task. Use this when you need functionality not provided by your currently available tools. The search queries against tool names, descriptions, and parameter information to find the most relevant tools. Returns references to matching tools which will be expanded into full definitions you can then invoke.
tools.defaultReason: Internal descriptor variant for generic client tool search, gated by GENERIC_CLIENT_TOOL_SEARCH. It is not another always-on public search function; model-facing search is normalized separately.

tools.name: glob
tools.label: Finding files
tools.description: Find files quickly by glob pattern.
tools.defaultReason: Literal baseline gate: glob is included before the session's later tool/agent filters.

tools.name: grep
tools.label: Searching files
tools.description: Search file contents quickly and precisely with ripgrep.
tools.defaultReason: Enabled for the reference profile's split editing style. Other models select rg/apply_patch or the combined str_replace_editor instead; later allow/exclude and agent filters still apply.

tools.name: grep_search
tools.label: Grep Search
tools.description: Search file contents in the workspace using text or a regular expression.
tools.defaultReason: Constrained search-agent tools materialized only for literal requests, not ordinary parent coding defaults. Preserve these names: their schemas/behavior differ from view/grep/glob and remote code-search tools.

tools.name: image_generation
tools.label: Generating image
tools.description: Generates or edits one PNG. Only invoke this tool when the user explicitly asks you to create or edit an image. Include input_images only when the user asks to edit an image or use it as a reference for a new image, otherwise omit them. Identify each input by its image_id or file path; never include unrelated attachments.
tools.defaultReason: Experimental. Requires online mode, an authorized Copilot image model, and the session's imageGeneration opt-in (disabled by default). Not available with BYOK providers; tool filters and permissions still apply. Not positively recognized by the native built-in override dispatcher; this snapshot does not promise an override for this fixed surface.

tools.name: invoke_canvas_action
tools.label: Invoking canvas action
tools.description: Invoke an action on an open canvas instance. Identify the panel by the instanceId you passed to open_canvas — do not pass canvasId or extensionId here. Action names and schemas come from list_canvas_capabilities for the canvas type.
tools.defaultReason: Requires canvas-renderer capability and applicable registered canvases/actions. Workspace flag is conservative: provider callbacks are opaque and can perform host effects; it is not a claim that every canvas needs files. Not positively recognized by the native built-in override dispatcher; this snapshot does not promise an override for this fixed surface.

tools.name: lexical_code_search
tools.label: GitHub Code Search
tools.description: Search remote indexed code on GitHub. Returns ranked file/line matches. Use local tools for checkout-specific code and direct reads for known files. Empty results do not prove absence: inspect warnings, fix syntax, or relax one guessed constraint without dropping required scope. Refine irrelevant results instead of retrying unchanged; read relevant files and validate behavior.
tools.defaultReason: Requires the corresponding Blackbird settings/experiment and online eligibility. Repository/authentication context is resolved at execution; workspace flag conservatively marks repository-context dependence.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.label: List Agents
tools.description: List background and sibling agents with their status and relation labels. The native description appends shared agent-communication guidance per session.
tools.defaultReason: Requires agent-management availability, which can come from task agents, existing tasks, custom agents, LSP, workflows, sibling communication, or MCP tasks. Uses task/session state rather than project files.

tools.name: list_bash
tools.label: List Bash sessions
tools.description: Lists active Bash command sessions and their status.
tools.defaultReason: Non-Windows shell family; selected on the macOS/Linux reference platform before later filters. The Windows family uses powershell/read_powershell/stop_powershell/list_powershell.

tools.name: list_canvas_capabilities
tools.label: Listing canvas capabilities
tools.description: Inspect a canvas *type* to discover its open input schema and supported actions (action names + input schemas). Takes a canvasId from the <canvases> section — not a running instanceId.
tools.defaultReason: Requires canvas-renderer capability. Lists host-provided canvas metadata; it does not itself operate on project files. Not positively recognized by the native built-in override dispatcher; this snapshot does not promise an override for this fixed surface.

tools.name: list_powershell
tools.label: List PowerShell sessions
tools.description: Lists active PowerShell command sessions and their status.
tools.defaultReason: Windows shell family, not simultaneously a default on the non-Windows reference platform. Shell selection aliases expand only to currently available platform tools.

tools.name: lsp
tools.label: Lsp
tools.description: Language Server Protocol tool for code intelligence. Operations: - goToDefinition: Find where a symbol is defined - findReferences: Find all usages of a symbol - rename: Semantically rename a symbol across files - hover: Get type info and documentation - documentSymbol: List all symbols in a file - workspaceSymbol: Search symbols across workspace - goToImplementation: Find implementations of an interface/type - incomingCalls: Find what calls a function - outgoingCalls: Find what a function calls
tools.defaultReason: Requires the shipped LSP leaf and available session LSP configurations. It can read project code and launch language-server processes.

tools.name: manage_schedule
tools.label: Manage schedule
tools.description: Manage scheduled prompts. Use action 'create' to schedule a new prompt (recurring), 'list' to see active schedules (both recurring and one-shot), or 'stop' with an id to cancel one. For 'create', provide either 'interval' (a relative cadence like '5m') or 'cron' (a 5-field calendar expression like '0 9 * * 1-5'), plus the 'prompt'. When you determine that a scheduled task's goal has been met, stop the schedule.
tools.defaultReason: Requires manage-schedule enablement. Workspace flag is conservative: scheduled prompts may later run native file/shell-capable agent work.

tools.name: open_canvas
tools.label: Opening canvas
tools.description: Open or focus a declared canvas. canvasId selects the canvas type (from the <canvases> section); instanceId is a handle you choose for this specific panel and reuse in later invoke_canvas_action calls. Re-opening the same instanceId focuses the existing panel; using a new instanceId opens an additional panel of the same canvas type.
tools.defaultReason: Requires canvas-renderer capability and applicable registered canvases/actions. Workspace flag is conservative: provider callbacks are opaque and can perform host effects; it is not a claim that every canvas needs files. Not positively recognized by the native built-in override dispatcher; this snapshot does not promise an override for this fixed surface.

tools.name: powershell
tools.label: Run PowerShell commands
tools.description: Runs a PowerShell command on the host; supports foreground and background command sessions.
tools.defaultReason: Windows shell family, not simultaneously a default on the non-Windows reference platform. Shell selection aliases expand only to currently available platform tools.

tools.name: read_agent
tools.label: Read Agent
tools.description: Read a background agent's status and results. Waiting behavior and guidance depend on session notification capabilities.
tools.defaultReason: Requires agent-management availability, which can come from task agents, existing tasks, custom agents, LSP, workflows, sibling communication, or MCP tasks. Uses task/session state rather than project files.

tools.name: read_bash
tools.label: Read Bash output
tools.description: Reads accumulated output from a running Bash command session.
tools.defaultReason: Non-Windows shell family; selected on the macOS/Linux reference platform before later filters. The Windows family uses powershell/read_powershell/stop_powershell/list_powershell.

tools.name: read_file
tools.label: Read File
tools.description: Read a range of lines from a file.
tools.defaultReason: Constrained search-agent tools materialized only for literal requests, not ordinary parent coding defaults. Preserve these names: their schemas/behavior differ from view/grep/glob and remote code-search tools.

tools.name: read_inbox
tools.label: Read Inbox
tools.description: Reads a message from the session inbox. * Use this when a system notification indicates a new inbox message. * If entry_id is omitted, reads the most recent unread inbox entry.
tools.defaultReason: Requires sidekick agents. Reads session inbox state rather than project files.

tools.name: read_memories
tools.label: Read Memories
tools.description: Fetch stored memories for this session. Returns facts, conventions, patterns, and practices learned from previous interactions.
tools.defaultReason: Requires an available memory service and a literal agent-definition request. Root-owned memory mutations are separate tools.

tools.name: read_powershell
tools.label: Read PowerShell output
tools.description: Reads accumulated output from a running PowerShell command session.
tools.defaultReason: Windows shell family, not simultaneously a default on the non-Windows reference platform. Shell selection aliases expand only to currently available platform tools.

tools.name: report_dreaming_artifact
tools.label: Report Dreaming Artifact
tools.description: Deliver a Dreaming artifact when requested by the job instructions. * Provide a short title and Markdown summary * Include structured data only when useful
tools.defaultReason: Requires the linked tool-handlers leaf and a literal Dreaming-job request. Delivers a progress artifact, not a project-file operation. Not positively recognized by the native built-in override dispatcher; this snapshot does not promise an override for this fixed surface.

tools.name: rg
tools.label: Rg
tools.description: Search file contents quickly and precisely with ripgrep.
tools.defaultReason: Model-dependent editing/search alternative, not an additional always-on editor. Apply-patch style selects rg and apply_patch; replace style selects str_replace_editor and omits standalone view/create/edit.

tools.name: run_dynamic_workflow
tools.label: Run workflow
tools.description: Starts a registered workflow by name, or resumes a prior run by ID, and returns immediately with a run ID while execution continues in the background. Use only when the user explicitly requests a workflow at this scale, or when a skill or slash command specifically instructs you to use one. Do not infer workflow use merely because a task could benefit from parallelism: a workflow may spawn dozens of agents and consume substantial credits. The limits are optional overrides: on a new run, omit them unless the user specified a ceiling.
tools.defaultReason: Experimental. Requires dynamic-workflow availability, including session capabilities/feature and quota policy. Workflows (formerly factories) can launch agents; authoring can write session-scoped JavaScript on the host. Not positively recognized by the native built-in override dispatcher; this snapshot does not promise an override for this fixed surface.

tools.name: search_code_subagent
tools.label: Search Code Subagent
tools.description: Searches the codebase with a constrained search-only subagent and returns relevant file paths and line ranges with hydrated code snippets.
tools.defaultReason: Requires online mode, allowed search-subagent filters, an eligible resolved model, and the appropriate request context. May search local project code and use a remote model. Not positively recognized by the native built-in override dispatcher; this snapshot does not promise an override for this fixed surface.

tools.name: semantic_code_search
tools.label: GitHub Code Search
tools.description: Search one GitHub repository's indexed default branch with a natural-language query. An experiment can select a focused-query description and schema.
tools.defaultReason: Requires the corresponding Blackbird settings/experiment and online eligibility. Repository/authentication context is resolved at execution; workspace flag conservatively marks repository-context dependence.

tools.name: semantic_search
tools.label: Semantic Search
tools.description: Search the current repository semantically for code relevant to a natural-language query.
tools.defaultReason: Constrained search-agent tools materialized only for literal requests, not ordinary parent coding defaults. Preserve these names: their schemas/behavior differ from view/grep/glob and remote code-search tools.

tools.name: send_inbox
tools.label: Send Inbox
tools.description: Send relevant context into the session inbox for the main agent to read later, with a concise summary and full content.
tools.defaultReason: Literal agent-definition request only; the '*' coding request does not admit this non-standard sidekick tool.

tools.name: session_store_sql
tools.label: Session Store Sql
tools.description: Query cross-session history. Available local, personal-cloud, organization, and repository scopes depend on session capabilities and configuration.
tools.defaultReason: Requires session-store capability and cloud-session-store enablement. Supported local/org/repo scopes and backend availability are conditional; not a project-file tool.

tools.name: skill
tools.label: Skill
tools.description: Load an available skill into the conversation. The native description incorporates the session's model-invocable skill catalog.
tools.defaultReason: Requires a non-empty model-invocable skill catalog. Workspace flag is conservative: disk-backed skill discovery/loading can read local assets, while a host-provided skill may be text-only.

tools.name: sql
tools.label: Sql
tools.description: Query and update the session SQLite database; some configurations also expose local cross-session history through this tool.
tools.defaultReason: Requires a session database. It operates on session/history storage, not arbitrary project files; workspace:false does not mean storage-free.

tools.name: stop_bash
tools.label: Stop Bash command
tools.description: Stops a running Bash command by terminating its process tree.
tools.defaultReason: Non-Windows shell family; selected on the macOS/Linux reference platform before later filters. The Windows family uses powershell/read_powershell/stop_powershell/list_powershell.

tools.name: stop_powershell
tools.label: Stop PowerShell command
tools.description: Stops a running PowerShell command by terminating its process tree.
tools.defaultReason: Windows shell family, not simultaneously a default on the non-Windows reference platform. Shell selection aliases expand only to currently available platform tools.

tools.name: store_memory
tools.label: Store Memory
tools.description: Store a fact in memory, so that it can be used in future code generation or review tasks. The fact should be a clear and concise statement about the codebase's conventions, structure, logic, or usage. It may be based on the code itself or on information provided by the user about the codebase.
tools.defaultReason: Requires memory capability, an available memory service, and root-owned mutation eligibility; voting has its own enablement. Storage may be remote or local, but these are not arbitrary project-file APIs. Not positively recognized by the native built-in override dispatcher; this snapshot does not promise an override for this fixed surface.

tools.name: str_replace_editor
tools.label: View/edit file
tools.description: View and edit files with the combined string-replacement editor selected for replace-style models.
tools.defaultReason: Model-dependent editing/search alternative, not an additional always-on editor. Apply-patch style selects rg and apply_patch; replace style selects str_replace_editor and omits standalone view/create/edit.

tools.name: task
tools.label: Task
tools.description: Delegate work to a configured built-in or custom subagent. The available agent list and native schema are assembled per session.
tools.defaultReason: Requires at least one visible dispatchable agent after model, agent-policy, and depth filtering. Workspace flag is conservative: delegated agents may use project files or host shells.

tools.name: task_complete
tools.label: Task complete
tools.description: Mark the current task as complete. Use this tool ONLY when you are confident the task is fully done.
tools.defaultReason: Offered in autopilot, or when plan-mode cache-stability treatment arms it. Retained tools may be no-ops outside their active mode; ordinary interactive mode does not imply availability. Not positively recognized by the native built-in override dispatcher; this snapshot does not promise an override for this fixed surface.

tools.name: tool_search_tool
tools.label: Search tools
tools.description: Searches for functions by matching a regex pattern against tool names, descriptions, and parameters. Returns matching tools that can then be called. Use this to discover available tools when you need a capability that isn't immediately visible.
tools.defaultReason: Specialized tool-search surface selected by model/provider, search settings, experiments, and deferred catalog availability. Explicit native overrides are supported through the specialized client_tool_search_override path; generic-client search is a distinct branch.

tools.name: update_todo
tools.label: Update Todo
tools.description: Use this TODO tool to manage the tasks that must be completed to solve the problem. Use this tool VERY frequently to keep track of your progress towards completing the overall goal, keeping all item statuses up to date. Call this tool to make the initial todo list for a complex problem. Then call this tool every time you finish a task and check off the corresponding item in the TODO list. If new tasks are identified, add them to the list as well. Re-planning is allowed if necessary.
tools.defaultReason: Compiled descriptor, selected by the runtime request/workflow and final agent-policy path. The runtime treats it as a required top-level-agent tool alongside skill, sql, and task_complete. It is not a dedicated operation in the legacy tool_assembly_plan; do not infer a universal coding default from registry membership. Not positively recognized by the native built-in override dispatcher; this snapshot does not promise an override for this fixed surface.

tools.name: view
tools.label: Viewing file
tools.description: View files, images, or directories. * Images return base64 data and MIME type. * Text files return their content. * Directories list non-hidden entries up to 2 levels deep. * `path` must be absolute. * Files over 20KB are truncated; use `view_range` for sections.
tools.defaultReason: Enabled for the reference profile's split editing style. Other models select rg/apply_patch or the combined str_replace_editor instead; later allow/exclude and agent filters still apply.

tools.name: vote_memory
tools.label: Vote Memory
tools.description: Vote on an existing memory by passing its exact fact text; the tool requires an exact string match. Use direction "upvote" for memories you have verified as useful and correct. Use direction "downvote" for memories that are incorrect or outdated, or that the user has asked you to delete, remove, or forget.
tools.defaultReason: Requires memory capability, an available memory service, and root-owned mutation eligibility; voting has its own enablement. Storage may be remote or local, but these are not arbitrary project-file APIs. Not positively recognized by the native built-in override dispatcher; this snapshot does not promise an override for this fixed surface.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.label: Fetching web content
tools.description: Fetches a URL from the internet and returns the page as either markdown or raw HTML. Use this to safely retrieve up-to-date information from HTML web pages.
tools.defaultReason: Literal online gate: included when the session is not offline. Network access is not a project-file capability; permission and policy checks remain separate.

tools.name: write_agent
tools.label: Write Agent
tools.description: Send a follow-up message to a running or idle background agent by its exact agent ID. The native description appends shared agent-communication guidance per session.
tools.defaultReason: Requires agent-management availability. Workspace flag is conservative: sending a turn can wake an agent that then uses native file/shell tools.
